How we learn your industry

Software that fits how you work

Before we design anything, we spend time with the people who will use it.

  • Map the day-to-day work

    We sit with your teams to see where time goes: site reports in construction, bookings in hospitality, fee collection in education, stock in retail.

  • Respect the rules you work under

    We plan for GST invoicing, data privacy, patient confidentiality, audit trails and any other requirements your sector has.

  • Fit the tools you already use

    New software connects to your accounting, payment and messaging tools, so nobody types the same data twice.

  • Start small, then grow

    We launch the most valuable part first, measure how it is used, and add the rest in planned phases.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you have experience in my industry?

We have worked across more than ten industries, including those listed on this page. If yours isn't listed, the same approach applies: we learn how your business works before we design anything.

How do you handle industry rules and regulations?

We plan for requirements such as GST invoicing, data privacy, patient confidentiality and audit trails from the start, and confirm the specifics with you during discovery.

Can you work with the software we already use?

Yes. New systems are integrated with your accounting, payment, messaging and other existing tools, so data isn't entered twice.

Do you only build from scratch?

No. Depending on your needs we build custom software, adapt one of our existing foundations or improve the systems you already have.

Don't see your industry?

We regularly work in new sectors. Tell us how your business runs and we'll show how we would approach it.
